alert.name: report-builder schedule failing
alert.summary: FailedInvocations / Invocations > 0.5 for 2 periods (report-builder schedule; m3 = AWS/Lambda Invocations FunctionName=vpc-report-builder, ReturnData=false)

logs: ALARM metric-math threshold GreaterThanThreshold 0.5 datapoints=2/2 missing=missing state=ALARM
CHANGE none on report-builder-every-15m in the 6 h before the alert
CHANGE none on vpc-report-builder in the 6 h before the alert
STATE lambda vpc-report-builder state=Failed reason=EniLimitExceeded last_update=Successful update_reason=-
CONFIG lambda vpc-report-builder timeout=300s memory=1024MB reserved_concurrency=none env=[REPORT_TABLE=reports-dev] sgs=[sg-0aa9bb8cc7dd6ee5f] version=5 alias_live=5
